JOIN {SCHEMA}.AGREGATEDPOLICY AP ON AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID=P.AGREGATEDOBJECTID
LEFT JOIN {SCHEMA}.PRODUCT PR ON PR.PRODUCTID = AP.PRODUCTID

AND PR.DESCRIPTION IN (${PRODUCTOS}) AND PP.COMPANIAVALUE IN (${COMPANIAS})) U ON U.OPERATIONPK=I.OPERATIONPK AND U.RISK_ID=I.AGREGATEDPARENTID
 GROUP BY I.OPERATIONPK,I.AGREGATEDPARENTID
) M ON M.OPERATIONPK=T.OPERATIONPK AND M.AGREGATEDPARENTID=T.AGREGATEDPARENTID AND M.AGREGATEDOBJECTID=T.AGREGATEDOBJECTID

SELECT T.* FROM {SCHEMA}.PRETHIRDPARTY T WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT THIRDPartyID FROM (SELECT P.* FROM {SCHEMA}.STPO_POLICYPARTICIPATION P WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT C.ID OPERATIONPK,P.DCOID POLICY_DCOID,P.AGREGATEDOBJECTID POLICY_ID,P.IDDCOEVENT,AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID,AP.PRODUCTID,R.DCOID RISK_DCOID,R.AGREGATEDOBJECTID RISK_ID,E.EVENTTYPEID

WITH POLIZAS_SATELITES AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID
    FROM {SCHEMA}.CONTEXTOPERATION C
    JOIN {SCHEMA}.POLICYDCO PD
      ON PD.OPERATIONPK = C.ID
    JOIN {SCHEMA}.AGREGATEDPOLICY AP
      ON AP.AGREGATEDPOLICYID =
         PD.AGREGATEDOBJECTID
    JOIN {SCHEMA}.PRODUCT PR
      ON PR.PRODUCTID = AP.PRODUCTID
    JOIN {SCHEMA}.PREPRODUCT PP
      ON PP.STATIC = AP.PRODUCTID
    WHERE C.STATUS IN (${STATUS_OPERACION})
      AND C.TIME_STAMP >= TO_DATE(
          '${FECHA_INICIO}',
          'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
      )
      AND C.TIME_STAMP < TO_DATE(
          '${FECHA_FIN}',
          'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
      )
      AND PR.DESCRIPTION IN (${PRODUCTOS})
      AND PP.COMPANIAVALUE IN (${COMPANIAS})
),
TOMADORES AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        P.THIRDPARTYID
    FROM {SCHEMA}.STPO_POLICYPARTICIPATION P
    JOIN POLIZAS_SATELITES B
      ON B.AGREGATEDPOLICYID =
         P.AGREGATEDPARENTID
    JOIN {SCHEMA}.STTS_ROLE R
      ON R.ROL_ID = P.ROL_ID
    WHERE P.THIRDPARTYID IS NOT NULL
      AND UPPER(R.ROL_DESCRIPTION)
          LIKE '%TOMADOR%'
)
SELECT
    T.*
FROM {SCHEMA}.THIRDPARTYROLE T
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM TOMADORES K
    WHERE K.THIRDPARTYID =
          T.THIRDPARTYID
)
